Shakirat Wunmi Taiwo, popularly known as Kira Ogogo, daughter of late Nollywood actor Taiwo Hassan, has made her debut as a filmmaker with the release of her first movie, Toriola. As reported by PM News on Friday, the film, produced under Kira Ogogo Film Production, marks a major milestone in her creative journey as she continues the legacy of her late father, who passed away in August 2026 after battling stage-four cancer. Directed by veteran filmmaker Abbey Lanre, Toriola tells the story of a young woman whose dreams of building a peaceful and successful life are shattered after she becomes entangled in deceit, jealousy and deep-rooted family secrets. As the story unfolds, she discovers that the people closest to her are behind the challenges threatening her future. In a tribute to her father’s longstanding contributions to Yoruba cinema, Kira assembled a cast of respected industry veterans, family friends and emerging talents to bring the project to life. In the video, the sisters expressed gratitude for the love shown to their family during their period of grief and appealed to fans to extend the same support to their individual ventures in acting and filmmaking. With Toriola, Kira Ogogo takes her first major step behind the camera, signalling a new chapter for the family in the Nigerian film industry.
